title: Easy + hill strides (+10min, Thu skip)
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 45min easy at 138-150bpm, then 6x20s strong uphill at 180+ spm, walk down, 5min cooldown.
GYM: none.
FUEL: none.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55 or sleep under 6h again, keep 35min and drop strides.
WHY: +10min recovers part of Thu's skipped spin without touching Saturday's legs.
